title: Negotiated original file gate recovery
description: control.fileGateResume.v1: unchanged P control-context and control frames. S pins the original local request after registration, authenticates the previous stopped attempt journal, and preserves original local identity and wait. P reuses only a selected checkpoint handoff with identical current material bytes and review metadata. Set/projected gates are excluded. Missing or changed request, material, provenance or owner binding refuses recovery.
